vector_db_chunks.text: The Ministry of Women and Child Development describes Women Helpline 181 as a toll-free 24-hour telephone service for women seeking support or information. It can connect callers with emergency response services, including police, fire, or ambulance, and with One Stop Centres and other support. A woman in distress, or someone calling on her behalf, may contact 181. In an emergency, call 181 or the applicable emergency service; the helpline does not decide legal claims or guarantee a particular outcome.
